# Classes, capabilities and actions

A device has one **class** and a list of **capabilities**. The class picks its card in the app, who may see it by default, the nouns voice understands, and which standard actions can name it. The capabilities narrow those actions to what this device can do, and their lists (inputs, modes, portions) narrow the values.

The hub owns the actions. A plugin never sees an action, a tier or a person: it receives one `Op` for one device, already checked against the action's parameter ranges, and first answers `Plugin::refusal` for it. Map your device onto these classes, capabilities and operations. Only when nothing fits, declare a custom action (last section).

## Device classes

| Class | Meaning | State it reports | Seen by default by | Approval | Standard actions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | A light that can be switched, dimmed and perhaps coloured. | `light` | family | no | `light.power`, `light.brightness`, `light.hue` |
| `bridge` | A bridge that other devices are reached through, such as a Hue Bridge. | `bridge` | family | no | none; reads, and custom actions |
| `plug` | A smart socket. | `plug` | owner | no | `plug.power` |
| `aircon` | An air conditioner. | `aircon` | owner | no | `ac.power`, `ac.mode`, `ac.temperature`, `ac.fan` |
| `speaker` | A speaker or sound bar. | `speaker` | family | no | `speaker.volume`, `speaker.mute`, `speaker.night`, `speaker.play`, `speaker.pause` |
| `tv` | A television. | `tv` | family | no | `tv.input`, `tv.key`, `tv.power` |
| `feeder` | A pet feeder. | `feeder` | family | no | `pets.feed` |
| `litter` | A litter box that cleans itself. | `litter` | family | no | `pets.clean` |
| `printer` | A 3D printer. | `printer` | owner | no | `print.estop`, `print.start`, `print.pause`, `print.resume` |
| `vm` | A virtual machine. | `vm` | owner | pending until a passkey approves it | `vm.start`, `vm.stop`, `vm.restart`, `vm.force_stop` |
| `host` | A host that runs virtual machines. | `host` | owner | pending until a passkey approves it | `host.shutdown`, `host.reboot` |
| `router` | A router, and the tunnel it runs. | `router` | owner | pending until a passkey approves it | `router.wireguard_restart` |
| `camera` | A camera. | `camera` | family | no | none; reads, and custom actions |
| `service` | A service on the network that is only checked for reachability. | `service` | owner | no | none; reads, and custom actions |
| `telemetry` | A source of readings, such as a node's sensors. | `telemetry` | owner | no | none; reads, and custom actions |
| `other` | Anything the hub has no class for. | `custom` | owner | no | none; reads, and custom actions |

## Capabilities

A device lists what it can do in `DeviceDecl::capabilities`. An action that names a capability admits only a device that has it, so a read-only speaker without `volume` is never sent `speaker.volume`. The lists inside a capability are the values this device accepts; `refusal` must turn down any other value with a sentence.

| Capability | JSON | Meaning | Actions that need it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `power` | `{"cap":"power"}` | Light, Plug, Aircon or Tv power. | `light.power`, `plug.power`, `ac.power`, `tv.power` |
| `brightness` | `{"cap":"brightness","min":10}` | Dimming. WiZ: 10. | `light.brightness` |
| `color` | `{"cap":"color"}` | Colour, as a hue angle 0..=359. | `light.hue` |
| `volume` | `{"cap":"volume"}` | Speaker volume. | `speaker.volume` |
| `mute` | `{"cap":"mute"}` | Speaker mute. | `speaker.mute` |
| `night_mode` | `{"cap":"night_mode"}` | Speaker night mode. | `speaker.night` |
| `transport` | `{"cap":"transport"}` | Speaker play and pause. | `speaker.play`, `speaker.pause` |
| `inputs` | `{"cap":"inputs","inputs":["HDMI 1","HDMI 2","Live TV"]}` | TV inputs. | `tv.input` |
| `keys` | `{"cap":"keys","keys":["up","down","ok","back"]}` | Remote keys. | `tv.key` |
| `mode` | `{"cap":"mode","modes":["auto","cool","heat"]}` | Aircon modes. | `ac.mode` |
| `temperature` | `{"cap":"temperature","min":17,"max":30}` | Target temperature, Celsius. | `ac.temperature` |
| `fan` | `{"cap":"fan","speeds":["auto","low","high"]}` | Fan speeds. | `ac.fan` |
| `dispense` | `{"cap":"dispense","grams":[10,20,30]}` | Food out of a feeder. | `pets.feed` |
| `clean` | `{"cap":"clean"}` | A litter box cleaning cycle. | `pets.clean` |
| `print_job` | `{"cap":"print_job"}` | Starting, pausing and resuming a print. | `print.start`, `print.pause`, `print.resume` |
| `emergency_stop` | `{"cap":"emergency_stop"}` | Stopping a printer at once. | `print.estop` |
| `lifecycle` | `{"cap":"lifecycle"}` | VM start, shutdown, reboot, force stop. | `vm.start`, `vm.stop`, `vm.restart`, `vm.force_stop` |
| `node_power` | `{"cap":"node_power"}` | Host shutdown, reboot. | `host.shutdown`, `host.reboot` |
| `tunnel` | `{"cap":"tunnel"}` | VPN tunnel restart. | `router.wireguard_restart` |
| `metrics` | `{"cap":"metrics"}` | A telemetry snapshot. | none: it tells the app and the hub what the device offers |
| `history` | `{"cap":"history"}` | Stored charts (`MachineHost::history`). | none: it tells the app and the hub what the device offers |
| `console` | `{"cap":"console"}` | VNC console (`MachineHost`). | `console.open` |
| `agent_pairing` | `{"cap":"agent_pairing"}` | The `AgentPairing` extension. | none: it tells the app and the hub what the device offers |
| `custom` | `{"cap":"custom","action":"acme-blinds.calibrate"}` | A plugin-declared action id. | the custom action it names |

## Standard actions

Every action a person, voice or Swifty can run on a device. **Tier**: 0 read, 1 comfort (runs at once), 2 consequential (prepare, then confirm), 3 critical (prepare, then a passkey), S safe direction (an emergency stop: runs at once, also by voice). **Idempotent**: only an idempotent action is sent a second time after silence; any other is sent exactly once. **Timeout**: how long the hub reads the state back before the run ends `no_response`.

| Class | Capability | Action (old id) | Sends | Tier | Idempotent | Timeout | Confirmed when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| any device | none | `state.read` | nothing: reads the state | 0 read | yes | 3000 ms | nothing to confirm |
| `light` | `power` | `light.power` (`bulb.power`) | `light_power` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `light.on` equals `on`. |
| `light` | `brightness` | `light.brightness` (`bulb.brightness`) | `light_brightness` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | The light is on and `bri` equals `percent` (a request under 10 is also met by 10, the lowest many lights go). `percent` 0 is also met by the light being off. |
| `light` | `color` | `light.hue` (`bulb.hue`) | `light_hue` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | The light is on, `color` is true and `hue` equals `hue`. |
| the word `all_bulbs` | none | `lights.power` | `light_power` on every light with `power` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| the word `all_bulbs` | none | `lights.brightness` | `light_brightness` on every light with `brightness` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| `speaker` | `volume` | `speaker.volume` (`sonos.volume`) | `volume` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `speaker.vol` equals `level`. |
| `speaker` | `mute` | `speaker.mute` (`sonos.mute`) | `mute` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `speaker.mute` equals `muted`. |
| `speaker` | `night_mode` | `speaker.night` (`sonos.night`) | `night_mode` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `speaker.night` is present and equals `on`. |
| `speaker` | `transport` | `speaker.play` (`sonos.play`) | `play` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `speaker.playing` is true. |
| `speaker` | `transport` | `speaker.pause` (`sonos.pause`) | `pause` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `speaker.playing` is false. |
| `tv` | `inputs` | `tv.input` | `tv_input` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | The TV is on and `tv.input` equals `input`. |
| `tv` | `keys` | `tv.key` | `tv_key` | 1 comfort | no | 8000 ms | Never: a key press leaves nothing to read back. The run ends `sent` once the TV accepts it. |
| the word `evening` or `focus` or `all_off` | none | `scene.apply` | On every light, by what it can do: `light_set`, `light_brightness`, or `light_power` | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| `plug` | `power` | `plug.power` | `plug_power` | 1 comfort | yes | 5000 ms | `plug.on` equals `on`. |
| `aircon` | `power` | `ac.power` | `aircon_power` | 1 comfort | yes | 30000 ms | `aircon.on` equals `on`. |
| `aircon` | `mode` | `ac.mode` | `aircon_mode` | 1 comfort | yes | 30000 ms | `aircon.mode` is `mode`. |
| `aircon` | `temperature` | `ac.temperature` | `aircon_temp` | 1 comfort | yes | 30000 ms | `aircon.target` is `celsius`. |
| `aircon` | `fan` | `ac.fan` | `aircon_fan` | 1 comfort | yes | 30000 ms | `aircon.fan` is `fan`. |
| a room | none | `room.power` | `light_power` on every light in the room | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| a room | none | `room.brightness` | `light_brightness` on every light in the room | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| a room | none | `room.scene` | On every light in the room, as `scene.apply`; Movie also the TV and the speaker | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| `printer` | `emergency_stop` | `print.estop` | `print_emergency_stop` | S safe_direction | yes | 8000 ms | `printer.state` is `"stopped"`. |
| `tv` | `power` | `tv.power` | `tv_power` | 2 consequential | yes | 8000 ms | `tv.on` equals `on`. |
| the word `movie` | none | `scene.movie` | As `scene.apply`, then `tv_power` and `tv_input` on the first TV, and `volume_cap` on the first speaker with a volume | 2 consequential | yes | 8000 ms | each operation by its own rule (ops.md) |
| `feeder` | `dispense` | `pets.feed` | `pet_feed` | 2 consequential | no | 45000 ms | `feeder.portions` is greater than before the command. |
| `litter` | `clean` | `pets.clean` | `litter_clean` | 2 consequential | no | 45000 ms | `litter.busy` is true, or `litter.cycles` is greater than before the command. |
| `printer` | `print_job` | `print.start` | `print_start` | 2 consequential | no | 8000 ms | `printer.state` is `"printing"`. |
| `printer` | `print_job` | `print.pause` | `print_pause` | 2 consequential | yes | 8000 ms | `printer.state` is `"paused"`. |
| `printer` | `print_job` | `print.resume` | `print_resume` | 2 consequential | yes | 8000 ms | `printer.state` is `"printing"`. |
| `vm` | `lifecycle` | `vm.start` | `vm_start` | 2 consequential | yes | 30000 ms | `vm.state` is `"running"`. |
| `vm` | `lifecycle` | `vm.stop` | `vm_shutdown` | 3 critical | yes | 180000 ms | `vm.state` is `"stopped"`. |
| `vm` | `lifecycle` | `vm.restart` | `vm_reboot` | 3 critical | no | 180000 ms | `vm.state` is `"running"` and `vm.uptime_s` is lower than before the command. |
| `vm` | `lifecycle` | `vm.force_stop` | `vm_force_stop` | 3 critical | yes | 30000 ms | `vm.state` is `"stopped"`. |
| `host` | `node_power` | `host.shutdown` | `host_shutdown` | 3 critical | yes | 20000 ms | `host.up` is false. |
| `host` | `node_power` | `host.reboot` | `host_reboot` | 3 critical | no | 20000 ms | `host.up` is true and `host.uptime_s` is lower than before the command. |
| `router` | `tunnel` | `router.wireguard_restart` | `wireguard_restart` | 3 critical | no | 20000 ms | `router.wireguard_up` is true and `router.uptime_s` is lower than before the command. |

### Parameters

The catalog checks every value against these before a plugin sees it, so `refusal` only has to turn down what this particular device does not accept.

| Action | Parameters |
| --- | --- |
| `state.read` | `metric`: one of `cpu_temp`, `power`, `memory`, `storage`, `bluetooth`, optional |
| `light.power` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `light.brightness` | `percent`: whole number, 1 to 100 |
| `light.hue` | `hue`: whole number, 0 to 359 |
| `lights.power` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `lights.brightness` | `percent`: whole number, 1 to 100 |
| `speaker.volume` | `level`: whole number, 0 to 100 |
| `speaker.mute` | `muted`: `true` or `false` |
| `speaker.night` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `tv.input` | `input`: one of `HDMI 1`, `HDMI 2`, `HDMI 3`, `HDMI 4`, `Live TV` |
| `tv.key` | `key`: one of `up`, `down`, `left`, `right`, `ok`, `back`, `home`, `exit`, `volume_up`, `volume_down`, `mute`, `channel_up`, `channel_down`, `play`, `pause` |
| `plug.power` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `ac.power` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `ac.mode` | `mode`: one of `auto`, `cool`, `heat`, `dry`, `fan` |
| `ac.temperature` | `celsius`: whole number, 17 to 30 |
| `ac.fan` | `fan`: one of `auto`, `quiet`, `low`, `medium_low`, `medium`, `medium_high`, `high` |
| `room.power` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `room.brightness` | `percent`: whole number, 1 to 100 |
| `room.scene` | `scene`: plain text, at most 40 characters |
| `tv.power` | `on`: `true` or `false` |
| `pets.feed` | `grams`: whole number, 10 to 50 |
| `vm.stop` | `acknowledge_console_offline`: `true` or `false`, optional |
| `vm.restart` | `acknowledge_console_offline`: `true` or `false`, optional |
| `vm.force_stop` | `acknowledge_console_offline`: `true` or `false`, optional |

### Value lists

The words the catalog accepts. A device's capability lists the ones it has, and is never wider than these.

- TV inputs (`tv.input`): `HDMI 1`, `HDMI 2`, `HDMI 3`, `HDMI 4`, `Live TV`
- TV keys (`tv.key`): `up`, `down`, `left`, `right`, `ok`, `back`, `home`, `exit`, `volume_up`, `volume_down`, `mute`, `channel_up`, `channel_down`, `play`, `pause`
- Air conditioner modes (`ac.mode`): `auto`, `cool`, `heat`, `dry`, `fan`
- Air conditioner fan speeds (`ac.fan`): `auto`, `quiet`, `low`, `medium_low`, `medium`, `medium_high`, `high`
- Readings `state.read` can highlight: `cpu_temp`, `power`, `memory`, `storage`, `bluetooth`

## Actions only the hub runs

These act on the hub itself, not on a device through a plugin. A plugin never receives them and must not offer anything like them. Machine approval and consoles reach a plugin only through the `MachineHost` and `AgentPairing` extensions of `Driver`.

| Action | Tier | Aimed at | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `passkey.register` | 3 critical | the word `new` | Opens a short window to add a new passkey to this console. |
| `passkey.revoke` | 3 critical | a passkey | This passkey can no longer sign in. |
| `user.invite` | 3 critical | the word `new` | Creates an invitation that adds one family member with their own passkey. |
| `user.remove` | 3 critical | a family member | This person can no longer sign in, and their passkeys are revoked. |
| `console.open` | 3 critical | `vm` | Opens one console session on this VM through its host's console proxy. |
| `machine.approve` | 3 critical | a device waiting for approval | Puts this VM on the approved list, so it can be controlled from here. |
| `machine.remove` | 3 critical | `vm` | Takes this VM off the approved list. Its host and the VM itself are not touched. |
| `proxmox.add_host` | 3 critical | the word `new` | Adds a further Proxmox host. VMs seen there are listed as pending until approved. |
| `proxmox.remove_host` | 3 critical | a further host | Takes this further Proxmox host off the list, with every machine listed on it. The host itself is not touched. |
| `agent.pair` | 3 critical | the word `new` | Starts the collector's own agent pairing. The agent only ever reports readings. |
| `plugin.add` | 3 critical | the word `new` | Starts the guided setup of a new integration. |
| `plugin.reconfigure` | 3 critical | an integration (a plugin instance), by its id | Starts the guided setup of this integration again, from its stored settings. |
| `plugin.remove` | 3 critical | an integration (a plugin instance), by its id | Removes this integration with its devices, their places in rooms, the favourites that name them, and its secrets. Nothing is sent to the devices. |

## Custom actions and their floors

When nothing above fits, a plugin declares a `CustomAction` in its manifest (manifest.md). The hub adds it to the catalog as `<plugin id>.<verb>` and sends it as `Op::Custom { action, args }`. It reaches only a device of the same plugin whose capabilities include `Capability::Custom { action }` with that id. Custom actions are for the owner only, and voice and Swifty never propose them.

The tier in the manifest is a request. The hub applies floors when it loads the manifest, and never lowers a tier:

- at least comfort;
- at least consequential when `idempotent` is false;
- at least critical on class `vm`, `host` or `router`;
- never read, never safe direction (the conformance suite refuses both).

`confirm_timeout_ms` is kept between 1000 and 180000 ms. The table is what the hub's `floor` function gives:

| Class | Idempotent | Asks comfort | Asks consequential | Asks critical |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| any other | yes | 1 comfort | 2 consequential | 3 critical |
| any other | no | 2 consequential | 2 consequential | 3 critical |
| `vm`, `host`, `router` | yes | 3 critical | 3 critical | 3 critical |
| `vm`, `host`, `router` | no | 3 critical | 3 critical | 3 critical |
